decision: promote bounded cold-cohort admission priority under the existing fair scheduler policy

implementation.cold_cohort: When no row is decode-ready, fair scheduling snapshots a cold prefill cohort only if every active row fits within the existing fair_prefill_burst_chunks bound. New bounded rows may join only before the first decode; the first decode clears the epoch.
implementation.submission_priority: A poller waits for submissions already queued on the short model-loop lock before starting the next model tick. Requests that were not already waiting receive no priority.
